[EN] Warriors of Kaiator! You must never forget!
Our hero, Kaidun, was an aman without horns.

You should remember, that hornless amans were despised for such a long time!

However! Kaidun proved them wrong with his dauntless courage.

Despite his physical flaw, he was the most worthy candidate for the next commander.

However! What happened to him?
While patrolling Southern Shara, he was ambushed by Thulsa.

Who could have done such a thing?Next page.
[ES] ¡Guerreros de Kaiator! ¡Nunca deben olvidar!
Nuestro héroe, Kaidun, era un aman sin cuernos.

¡Deben recordar que los amans sin cuernos fueron despreciados durante muchísimo tiempo!

¡Sin embargo! Kaidun les demostró que estaban equivocados con su valor indomable.

A pesar de su defecto físico, era el candidato más digno para el próximo comandante.

¡Sin embargo! ¿Qué le pasó?
Mientras patrullaba el sur de Shara, fue emboscado por Thulsa.

¿Quién pudo haber hecho tal cosa?Next page.

[EN] I swear to Kaia that someone is behind this.

Someone with a dark ambition to become the next commander.

Fellow amans, you must know the truth.
This conspiracy must be unmasked!

They say that in the end, justice will be victorious.
You must be aware of...

¡Esta conspiración debe ser desenmascarada!
